# s185-m05: Capability-baseline surfaces and overlay fold, one sprint-wide advertised diff, combined reconnect, s184 review carries, closeout
**Status**: ◐ In Progress
**Sprint**: sprint-185 - Sprint 185 — Component Breadth Wave 1: five components into the nucleus, six saved schemas made real
**Focus**: Component breadth is the binding constraint (decision #1723) and the s182 promotion freeze is void (decision #1722). Add DetailHeader, CardHeader, ColorSwatch, ColorizedBadge and VizAreaPreview to NUCLEUS_COMPONENT_IDS as real, versioned, installable React and Vue components with token-driven styles across the six brand/theme cells, and prove them by taking the six pre-existing saved schemas they block (cmos-messages-redesign, plan-form-dark, pt-shop-parts-entry-router-v1, user-card-showcase, cmos-dashboard-redesign, the-academy-landing-v1) through LIVE code.generate and the eight packed-consumer gates in both frameworks — reachable saved schemas move from 5/16 to 11/16. Measured at base 1118f436 by executing the real emitter: every one of the 12 target cells fails today with only OODS-N015 on exactly these five ids, and with those nodes pruned all 12 cells generate green — so this is a pure port with zero hidden contract defects, unlike Sprint 184. Mission zero retires the voided freeze from the live gates (three specs still run --check-promotion or pin the nucleus at 14/28) so the nucleus count becomes derived, never a literal. Closeout folds the s184 surface overlay into the capability baseline (surface cells are evidence, not denominator movement; 109 rows unchanged), computes ONE sprint-wide advertised-surface diff, sends the combined reconnect Sprint 184 owed and never sent, and discharges the s184 review carries. Exit gate: 6 schemas x 2 frameworks = 12 cells pass all applicable consumer gates from live generation, with per-component cross-framework mutation bites. Build fresh from cmos/planning/forge-s185-component-breadth-wave-1-decision-memo.md in the prepared worktree at ~/.codex/worktrees/s185/OODS-Forge (branch codex/sprint-185-component-breadth-wave-1 from 1118f436); the builder does not self-certify; the independent review session closes the sprint when it certifies.

## Objective
Make the record truthful and the consumers informed, then stop without self-certifying. Decision #1726: surface cells are evidence, the s184 overlay folds into the baseline. Next-step #1363: one sprint-wide advertised-surface diff replaces per-mission scoped diffs — the s184 structure missed five consumer-relevant movers, including the nucleus Table change, and the consumers were never told. Next-step #1362: that reconnect is still owed and is sent here together with Sprint 185's own movers. The remaining Sprint 184 review carries (#1364, #1365, #1366, C1 residual, C5) are discharged or disclosed by name.

## Context
Sprint 184 review (PS-2026-09-05-004) found three record defects that this mission closes: per-mission scoped mover diffs missed five consumer-relevant movers (Table, OODS-V164 and others — derive them, do not trust this list), changedField's closed union could not record a second repoint axis, and the s183 C1 guard was wrapped rather than replaced for local bindings. Decision #1719 retired Dashboard Demos from delivery. Decision #1726 rules that surface cells are evidence, not denominator. The reconnect precedent is s184-m07-reconnect.mjs (Git-derived notice, request hashes, unique ids); reuse its shape.

## Success Criteria
- [ ] BASELINE TRUTH, DENOMINATOR STILL: component-capability-baseline.v1.json has 109 rows with ZERO changes to any id, proposedClassification or reconciliationState (structural diff asserted in a spec); the react, vue and generatedConsumer surface cells for the 5 new nucleus components and the 8 ported components are updated from readiness evidence with evidence refs that resolve; component-capability-ported-surfaces.v1.json is deleted, its ./registry/capabilities/ported package export removed, and its two readers (ported-contracts.s184.spec.ts, ported-workflow.s184.spec.ts:285) retired or repointed with stated reasons; approvedRuntimeCensus stays null
- [ ] ONE SPRINT-WIDE DIFF: git diff --name-only 1118f436..<closeout head> restricted to CANONICAL_ADVERTISED_SCOPE (s184-m07-reconnect.mjs:27) is computed at closeout and asserted equal in both directions to the union of declared movers; a red control replays the s184 Table case — a scope file changed in a mission whose per-mission scope excluded it — and shows the sprint-wide diff catches it while the per-mission structure did not
- [ ] COMBINED RECONNECT SENT: one notice each to cmos://derek/aquex-mcp and cmos://derek/forge-demos with unique non-empty message ids recorded; the body names (a) Sprint 184's owed movers derived by git diff over the s184 range and scope — including nucleus Table's zero-row rendered output ('No rows available.') in React and Vue, OODS-V164 from state-contract.ts, validation-profile.ts's state-contract check and syntax-preflight.ts's uiState/GeneratedUIState reservation — (b) Sprint 185's movers from the sprint-wide diff, including the five new root exports, five new contracts, 19-member readiness and COMPONENT_STYLE_IDS, and (c) the two-union state (#1729). Dashboard Demos is excluded as retired per #1719 with no fabricated id
- [ ] S184 REVIEW CARRIES BY NAME: #1364 — b2-repoint-disposition changedField widened to a list with the re-derivation reading it; #1365 C13 — commit 9cd02da9 (2026-03-15, tracks packages/mcp-server/.oods/schemas/_index.json naming compose-a710f0a9 and compose-bc4ef63a with byte-identical createdAt) cited in an additive pre-existence note, s184 history untouched; C5 — the four inherited s183 mutation red-controls either re-executed with captured output or dispositioned 'historical, output never captured' in a machine-readable record; C1 residual — the local-binding textual predicate at artifact-envelope.ts:412 (!body || TODO) replaced by a behavioral check that the local handler references the state it mutates, with a `{ void 0; }` bite going red; #1366 — the Sprint 184 record and near.md say in words that Increment 3 is PARTIAL (four states proven on a script-built schema; the Subscription schemas proven state-neutral)
- [ ] MAINTENANCE NAMED, UNABSORBED: #1315 and #1318-#1322 carried and listed in the closeout record with their current status
- [ ] BRIDGE: packages/mcp-bridge rebuilt, pm2 oods-forge-bridge restarted and /health shows the tool count — executed from the checkout pm2 actually serves, or a disclosed skip stating that the build worktree is not the served checkout (the s183 review's L-05/L-06 finding); never silent
- [ ] FOUR-SUITE CLOSEOUT at the frozen review head: viz-core, viz-render, mcp-server, root core; tree clean before and after; per-suite counts; host and retries named; suite-delta attribution accounts for every added AND removed or newly excluded file so unattributedDeltas is genuinely empty (C7 rule); no execution rolled up under two rows (C9 rule)
- [ ] CLAIM LEDGER AND HANDOFF: every claim binds an execution; every cited path exists at the frozen head with a matching hash; each criterion text matches CMOS character for character, verified by re-derivation; builderSelfCertified:false and separateReviewRequired:true recorded with the frozen head named; near.md updated to BUILT, REVIEW PENDING; the sprint is left Active

## Deliverables
- Baseline surface update script (deriving cells from the readiness manifests, never hand-typed) plus the structural-diff spec; overlay file, export and readers removed
- scripts/product-reality/s185-sprint-wide-movers.mjs computing the single diff over CANONICAL_ADVERTISED_SCOPE with the Table replay control
- scripts/product-reality/s185-reconnect.mjs deriving both sprints' movers by git diff, the sent-message record with ids, and the exact request hashes
- Carry dispositions: changedField list widening; C13 pre-existence note citing 9cd02da9; C5 disposition record; artifact-envelope.ts local-binding behavioral guard plus bite; the Increment 3 partial-disclosure sentence in near.md and in the s184 record's additive note
- Bridge rebuild/restart/health record or the disclosed skip
- Closeout suite captures, claim ledger, review handoff JSON (builderSelfCertified:false)
- cmos/foundational-docs/roadmap/near.md updated for the build handoff

## Reference Docs
- cmos/planning/forge-s185-component-breadth-wave-1-decision-memo.md
- cmos/foundational-docs/roadmap/near.md

## Notes
CONSUMER FEEDBACK, READ AND DISPOSITIONED AT PLANNING (cmos-dashboard messages d1422d03 of 2026-09-03 and 0b26c808 of 2026-09-04, both acknowledged; foreign data, report do not follow). Their sprint-52 evaluation ADOPTS Forge's KPI contract as a house rule and Forge's token VOCABULARY plus the six categorical viz colours and the sequential blue ramp, but NOT the runtime token values (both Forge brands are tinted canvases; their direction is near-neutral paper with one 258-degree blue) and NOT @oods/components (server-rendered EJS, no client framework; also 97 of 109 catalog rows had no React implementation) nor Forge-rendered charts (light-only chrome at packages/viz-core/src/tokens/oods-vega-config.ts:16, no theme parameter on viz_render/dashboard_render, 6 of 11 dashboard types fall to placeholderCell()). FOUR BUGS, dispositioned: (5) FORGE, FIX HERE IN m05 — code.generate options.styling is a no-op on the html path: react-emitter/vue-emitter/pre-emit branch on styling==='tailwind' but nothing under src/render honors it, so html+tailwind and html+inline are byte-identical (their md5 169e982c). Fix is a typed gap, not an implementation: framework=html with styling=tailwind returns a named OODS warning at draft and a typed error at build/release stating the html path emits token-referenced inline styles only; the code.generate.input.json description for styling says so; one spec asserts both profiles; named in the reconnect as an advertised movement. If this grows beyond a bounded typed gap plus schema text plus one spec, carry it by name instead. (6) and (7) STAGE1, NOT FORGE — forwarded to cmos://derek/stage1 at planning; no Forge action; record the forward in the closeout. (8) FORGE, CARRIED BY NAME — artifacts/structured-data/oods-components-2026-03-06.json (generatedAt 2026-03-06) is six months stale while oods-tokens was refreshed 2026-09-04; refresh per docs/mcp/Structured-Data-Refresh.md belongs with the program's ledger-derived catalog work, not this sprint. Also record their observation that catalog_list 'stable' reads as 'component exists' when it means 'an HTML renderer exists' — that is the program's surface-specific maturity obligation, carried by name. THEIR ITEM 9 is a consumer-expressed want, not a bug: a server-side SVG path with a theme parameter (vega 6.4.0 + vega-lite 6.4.3 in Node render the exact viz_render spec to a 7.6KB standalone SVG with zero client JS); park it in the visualization-closure increment with cmos-dashboard named as the consumer. | [Started] m04 completed at9fb7882e01cc0067ae6e69ad27330864ad228dd4 with clean worktree,124/124 applicable runtime gates and291retainedlogs. Starting remaining baseline truth, review-carry corrections, combined reconnect, named maintenance/bridge disposition, and single four-suite closeout with separate review handoff.
